articles.title: Why Leaders Hit a Growth Ceiling and How to Break Through
articles.excerpt: The habits that got you here are rarely the ones that take you further.
articles.body:
Every leader eventually reaches a point where effort alone stops producing growth.

## Name the ceiling
The first step is to describe it honestly. Is it a capacity problem, a people problem, or a clarity problem?

## Change the question
Instead of asking how to work harder, ask what must change in me for the next level to be possible.

articles.title: To Scale Your Business, You Must Scale Your People
articles.excerpt: Systems and strategy matter, but growth is carried by people.
articles.body:
Organisations grow at the speed of their people.

Invest in the development of the team before you invest in the next campaign.

articles.title: Operating Systems Don't Write Themselves
articles.excerpt: Clear ways of working do not appear by accident.
articles.body:
Culture is the operating system of an organisation, and somebody has to write it.

Decide what you want to be true, write it down, and model it every day.
